subject: general
question: What will be the amount due on ₹24,000 in 2 years when the rate of simple interest on successive years is 4% per annum and 5% per annum, respectively?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Simple Interest** rate for 2 years = R₁ + R₂ = 4% + 5% = 9%.

Total **Simple Interest** = 9% of ₹24,000 = 0.09 × 24,000 = ₹2,160.

Total **Amount Due** = Principal + Interest = ₹24,000 + ₹2,160 = ₹26,160.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26,160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Principal (P)** = ₹24,000, **Rate for 1st year (R₁)** = 4%, **Rate for 2nd year (R₂)** = 5%, **Time (T)** = 2 years.

**Formula Used:** **Simple Interest (SI)** = (P × R × T) / 100 and **Amount (A)** = P + SI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/189e4135cf0e4d18cd1539c2ed612ac9f38f557433bda0fec6857a85937f665e.png] 

⇒ Interest for Year 1 = (24,000 × 4 × 1) ÷ 100 = ₹960

⇒ Interest for Year 2 = (24,000 × 5 × 1) ÷ 100 = ₹1,200

⇒ Total **Simple Interest** = 960 + 1,200 = ₹2,160

⇒ Total **Amount** = 24,000 + 2,160 = ₹26,160

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26,160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest on Successive Rates

In **Simple Interest**, different rates for different years are simply added to find the net effective rate: Rₑff = R₁ + R₂ + R₃...

Amount Formula

The total **Amount** can also be calculated directly using the formula: A = P × (1 + (R₁ + R₂ + ... + Rₙ)/100).

SI vs Compound Interest

Unlike **Compound Interest**, the interest in **Simple Interest** is always calculated on the original **Principal**, making it easier to sum up annual interest amounts.
